disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in a material respect to complete any construction project for the price stated in the contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in a material respect to complete any construction project or operation for the price stated in the contract for the project or operation or any modification of the contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal without legal excuse to prosecute a construction project with reasonable diligence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal without legal excuse to prosecute a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and prejudicial departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and prejudicial departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the owner or the owners authorized representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of the building laws of the State or any political subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of: (1) The building laws of the State or of any political subdivision thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion of money or property received for a specific construction project to any other project or purpose.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion of money or property received for the completion of a specific construction project or operation or for a specified purpose in the completion of any construction project or operation to any other construction project or operation, obligation or purpose.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay money when due for materials or services when the licensee has the capacity to pay.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure by any licensee or agent or officer thereof to pay any money when due for any materials or services rendered in connection with the licensees operations as a contractor, when the licensee has the capacity to pay

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to keep records showing all contracts, documents, receipts and disbursements open for inspection by the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to keep records showing all contracts, documents, receipts and disbursements by a licensee of all of the licensees transactions as a contractor and to keep them open for inspection by the Board or Executive Officer for a period of not less than 3 years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or omission of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in connection with information furnished to the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or omission of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in connection with any information or evidence furnished the Board in connection with official matters of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to keep in force the required bond or cash deposit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to keep in force the bond or cash deposit pursuant to NRS 624.270 for the full period required by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under a license except in the name of the licensee or as an employee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license issued hereunder except: (a) In the name of the licensee as set forth upon the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor beyond the scope of the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor beyond the scope of the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly entering into a contract with a contractor while that contractor is not licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly entering into a contract with a contractor while that contractor is not licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any fraudulent or deceitful act committed in the capacity of a contractor, including misrepresentation or omission of a material fact.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any fraudulent or deceitful act committed in the capacity of a contractor, including, without limitation, misrepresentation or the omission of a material fact.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of a contractor or a crime involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of a violation of NRS 624.730, or a conviction in this State or any other jurisdiction of a felony relating to the practice of a contractor or a crime involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Workmanship not commensurate with standards of the trade or below applicable building or construction codes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Workmanship which is not commensurate with standards of the trade in general or which is below the standards in the building or construction codes adopted by the city or county in which the work is performed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting, offering to contract, or submitting a bid while the contractor's license is suspended, revoked, or inactive.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Contracting, offering to contract or submitting a bid as a contractor if the contractors license: (a) Has been suspended or revoked pursuant to NRS 624.300; or (b) Is inactive.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or other disciplinary action taken by another state against a contractor based on a license issued by that state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The suspension, revocation or other disciplinary action taken by another state against a contractor based on a license issued by that state if the contractor is licensed in this State or applies for a license in this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to respond to a written request from the Board or its designee to cooperate in the investigation of a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to respond to a written request from the Board or its designee to cooperate in the investigation of a complaint.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements intended to induce another person to use the contractor's services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When a contractor makes any false or misleading statement or representation of material fact that is intended, directly or indirectly, to induce another person to use the services of the contractor or to enter into any contract with the contractor
